name: More Than Just a Kiss
source: It's your first day in Atleos, and when you go out for a night on the town, nothing goes as planned. Luckily, a handsome stranger shows up to give you a tour of the island you won't soon forget.
translation: 这是你来到Atleos的第一天。夜里，你出门感受当地的夜生活，却发现一切都不按计划发展。幸好，一位英俊的陌生人出现了，要带你进行一场令人久久难忘的海岛之旅。
